system.description:
Self-propelled ancient artillery on wheels (moves 6" per turn, no charge used). Range 24": each charge smashes through a six-foot wall (2" diameter area), or does 10d6 to a being.

Charges: roll d100 when found. Rechargeable with the Thoroughly Useful Eye.

How many exist: at least fifteen (three in the Imperial arsenal at Avanthár). Never for sale, though one may sometimes be borrowed from a temple or the Imperium for a mission.
